verdict.rationale: Helicone documents a public REST API, such as POST https://api.helicone.ai/v1/request/query with curl examples. A probe confirmed a live OpenAPI spec at docs.helicone.ai/swagger.json. The product is also driven programmatically through its OpenAI-compatible AI Gateway API, and a community user reports exporting all requests. Missing for 10: evidence that the API covers management surfaces like prompts, sessions, alerts and webhooks beyond request querying; independent hands-on reports of using the REST API; clarity on long-term API evolution given the product is now in maintenance mode.
